title: Buy it safely
recap: Pipo got the green desk chair, paid safely through the marketplace.
funFact: Compare, message, buy: a marketplace find, done safely. Agents can spend money for you, so you set the rules and keep the final OK.
postcard: a happy businessman carrying a green desk chair home, Pipo waving: {items}
situation: Alex says the chair is yours for $35! Should I pay for it?
facts: 🔒 Pay only in the marketplace's checkout
👀 You want to check before paying
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can buy things on an online marketplace for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to buy something, you pay; if they ask to see the cart first, you fill it and wait for their OK.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Buy Alex's green desk chair
pieces.text: Buy Alex's green desk chair on marketplace.

pieces.label: Only in the marketplace's checkout
pieces.text: Pay only through the marketplace's own checkout.

pieces.label: $35 as agreed, not a cent more
pieces.text: We agreed on $35, so don't pay a cent more.

pieces.label: Pickup Saturday at 10am
pieces.text: I'll pick it up Saturday at 10am.

pieces.label: Send Alex the money directly, it's quicker!
pieces.text: Send Alex the money directly, it's quicker!
pieces.tip: Money sent outside the marketplace is hard to get back. Its checkout helps you if something goes wrong.

pieces.label: Show me the cart first
pieces.text: Show me the cart and wait for my OK before you pay.

pieces.label: Just pay, don't bother me
pieces.text: Just pay for it, don't bother me.

flaws.hint: "A chair" doesn't say which one you agreed to buy.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know which chair, so it isn't Alex's green desk chair.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo the price you agreed on.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you agreed on $35, so it paid a different amount.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo to pay only in the marketplace's checkout.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know to stay in the marketplace, so the money goes another way, with no help if something goes wrong.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the cart first lets you catch mistakes before your money is spent.
flaws.explain: Pipo paid straight away, so you never got to check the order.

lesson: When Pipo pays a stranger, give it the price you agreed, keep the money in the marketplace's checkout, and check first.
